title: 杞人忧天
subtitle: 天空会掉下来吗

moral.zh: 担心时先找事实、问清楚，再把精力放回今天能做的事。
moral.en: When worry grows, look for facts, ask for help, and return to what you can do today.

idiomMeaning.zh: 杞国人担心天会塌下来；比喻为没有根据或不必担忧的事情发愁。
idiomMeaning.en: A man of Qi worried that the sky would fall—an expression for fretting over something without good reason.

visualAnchor: Ancient state of Qi village with packed-earth lanes, low gray-tiled homes, willow trees and a broad open sky; the worried man is a gentle slim 30-year-old with an oval clean-shaven face, high simple topknot, rust-orange cross-collar robe, dark-brown sash, charcoal trousers and cloth shoes; his calm friend is a sturdy 32-year-old with round face, short moustache, low bun, deep-teal robe, cream sash and brown cloth shoes; fixed small blue paper kite with a long cream tail; all reassurance is kind and evidence-based, never mocking

pages.zh: 杞国有个人常常仰望天空，越看越觉得不安。
pages.en: A man in the state of Qi often stared at the sky until worry filled his thoughts.
pages.prompt: wide establishing village scene, the worried man stands in his courtyard looking up at the immense calm sky while neighbors continue ordinary daily life

pages.zh: 他担心天会掉下来，连饭也吃不香，夜里也睡不好。
pages.en: He feared the sky might fall, and the thought spoiled his meals and sleep.
pages.prompt: quiet early-evening home scene, the worried man sits beside an untouched simple meal and looks through the open doorway at the peaceful sky, tired but safe

pages.zh: 朋友听说后，没有笑他，而是陪他到村外走一走。
pages.en: His friend did not laugh. He invited him to take a walk beyond the village.
pages.prompt: the calm friend gently invites the worried man along a sunny village path, supportive body language, open fields ahead

pages.zh: 他们感受风、看云和飞鸟，发现天空一直安稳地展开。
pages.en: They felt the wind and watched clouds and birds move through the steady sky.
pages.prompt: both men in an open meadow observing drifting clouds, swallows and grass bending in the breeze, the friend gestures calmly toward visible evidence

pages.zh: 朋友说：“能担心的事，要看有没有真实的迹象。”
pages.en: “A worry deserves attention when there is real evidence,” his friend explained.
pages.prompt: gentle teaching moment beneath a willow tree, the friend points to the stable ground and calm horizon while the worried man listens thoughtfully

pages.zh: “如果只是反复想象，就先深呼吸，再找人问清楚。”
pages.en: “If it is only an imagined fear, breathe slowly and ask someone you trust.”
pages.prompt: both men practice one slow calming breath beside the fixed blue kite, relaxed shoulders and warm afternoon light

pages.zh: 他终于明白：没有根据地发愁，就是杞人忧天。
pages.en: He understood that baseless worry was what people called fearing the sky like the man of Qi.
pages.prompt: turning point, the worried man's expression softens into relief as he looks at the wide sky with clearer understanding, friend beside him

pages.zh: 从此他学会查清事实，也重新安心吃饭、睡觉和生活。
pages.en: From then on, he checked the facts and returned to eating, sleeping, and living with ease.
pages.prompt: hopeful sunset ending, both friends fly the fixed blue kite in the field while the once-worried man smiles calmly, village glowing in the distance

title: 专心致志
subtitle: 弈秋的两位学生

moral.zh: 把注意力放在眼前的一步，认真听、认真想，学习才会真正发生。
moral.en: Learning grows when we give the present step our full attention and thought.

idiomMeaning.zh: 把全部心思集中在一件事上；形容一心一意、聚精会神。
idiomMeaning.en: To focus one's whole mind on one task—with complete attention and purpose.

visualAnchor: Warring States garden teaching pavilion with dark wooden posts, woven mats, bamboo grove and a low square wooden weiqi table; teacher Yi Qiu is a kind lean elderly man with long neat gray beard, high scholar bun, deep-brown robe, muted-gold sash and cream inner collar; the focused student is a 12-year-old child with round face, one small topknot, moss-green robe and beige sash; the distracted student is the same age with oval face, side-tied topknot, sky-blue robe and rust sash; fixed smooth black and ivory game stones with no markings; wild geese may appear only high in the sky

pages.zh: 弈秋是有名的下棋老师，一天收下了两位学生。
pages.en: Yi Qiu was a famous game teacher. One day, two students came to learn from him.
pages.prompt: wide establishing pavilion scene, Yi Qiu welcomes both students at the fixed low weiqi table in the bamboo garden

pages.zh: 老师摆下一颗棋子，慢慢讲清每一步为什么这样走。
pages.en: He placed one stone and carefully explained the reason behind each move.
pages.prompt: teacher places one black stone on the board and gestures to nearby positions while both students sit opposite him

pages.zh: 绿衣学生专心听讲，眼睛一直跟着棋盘上的变化。
pages.en: The student in green listened closely and followed every change on the board.
pages.prompt: focused green-robed student studies the board with attentive eyes while Yi Qiu explains, balanced medium scene

pages.zh: 蓝衣学生听见雁叫，心里只想着天空中的大雁。
pages.en: The student in blue heard geese and began thinking only about the birds overhead.
pages.prompt: blue-robed student turns toward a small flock of wild geese high beyond the pavilion while teacher and green student remain engaged, no hunting objects

pages.zh: 轮到他落子时，他才发现自己漏听了好几步。
pages.en: When his turn came, he realized he had missed several important steps.
pages.prompt: blue-robed student holds one game stone uncertainly above the board, puzzled but not shamed, teacher waits patiently

pages.zh: 弈秋请他收回目光，先看懂眼前这一颗棋子。
pages.en: Yi Qiu gently asked him to return his attention to the single move before him.
pages.prompt: teacher points kindly to one clear board position as the blue-robed student turns back and settles his posture

pages.zh: 同样跟老师学习，专心致志的人才能真正学会。
pages.en: The same lesson bears fruit when a learner gives it wholehearted attention.
pages.prompt: turning point, both students now study the same move carefully, green student confident and blue student newly focused

pages.zh: 后来，两位学生都学会先静下心，再一步一步思考。
pages.en: Later, both students learned to quiet their minds and think one move at a time.
pages.prompt: hopeful late-afternoon game, both students play thoughtfully while Yi Qiu watches with a warm approving smile

title: 朝三暮四
subtitle: 七颗栗子的算法

moral.zh: 别只被说法牵着走，要看清总数和事实，也要把规则讲明白。
moral.en: Look past changing words to the whole fact, and make rules clear and fair.

idiomMeaning.zh: 原指用不同说法改变感受，实际内容不变；后来也形容反复无常。
idiomMeaning.en: Originally, changing the wording while the total stayed the same; later, it also came to describe fickle changes.

visualAnchor: Ancient Song hillside monkey keeper's courtyard with bamboo fence, chestnut tree, stone feeding ledge and warm autumn light; the keeper is a patient 55-year-old man with kind square face, short gray beard, low bun, ochre-brown robe, deep-teal sash and cloth shoes; four fixed golden-brown macaques have cream faces, dark hands, long tails and distinct child-friendly expressions; fixed small woven morning basket, larger evening basket and glossy brown chestnuts, with quantities shown only by visible objects and never by written numerals

pages.zh: 宋国有位老人照顾一群猴子，每天都给它们分栗子。
pages.en: An old keeper in Song cared for a lively group of monkeys and shared chestnuts with them each day.
pages.prompt: wide establishing autumn courtyard, keeper greets the four macaques beside the chestnut tree and two empty woven baskets

pages.zh: 一天栗子不多，他说：“早上三颗，晚上四颗。”
pages.en: One day he said, “Three in the morning and four in the evening.”
pages.prompt: keeper places exactly three chestnuts in the small morning basket and exactly four in the evening basket as monkeys watch, no numerals

pages.zh: 猴子们一听早上只有三颗，全都不高兴地摇头。
pages.en: Hearing that morning meant only three, the monkeys shook their heads unhappily.
pages.prompt: four macaques react with mild disappointment toward the small basket, expressive but peaceful, keeper thoughtful

pages.zh: 老人换个说法：“那就早上四颗，晚上三颗吧。”
pages.en: The keeper changed the wording: “Then four in the morning and three at night.”
pages.prompt: keeper calmly swaps the basket contents so the morning basket has exactly four chestnuts and evening basket exactly three

pages.zh: 猴子们立刻欢呼，却没发现一天还是一共七颗。
pages.en: The monkeys cheered, not noticing that the daily total was still seven.
pages.prompt: macaques clap happily around the four-chestnut morning basket while both baskets remain visible for comparison

pages.zh: 老人把两篮栗子放在一起，请它们重新数一遍。
pages.en: The keeper set both baskets together and invited them to count again.
pages.prompt: keeper lines up all seven chestnuts in one clear row on the stone ledge while monkeys count with curious faces, no written symbols

pages.zh: 大家明白了：朝三暮四，变的是说法，不是总数。
pages.en: They understood: morning-three-evening-four changed the words, not the total.
pages.prompt: turning point, monkeys compare the two baskets and the row of seven chestnuts with dawning understanding

pages.zh: 从此老人把分法讲清楚，猴子们也学会先看完整。
pages.en: After that, the keeper explained the whole plan, and the monkeys learned to look at the full picture.
pages.prompt: hopeful feeding scene, keeper shares chestnuts fairly while all four macaques wait calmly beside both clearly visible baskets

title: 开卷有益
subtitle: 每天打开一卷书
origin: 宋·王辟之《渑水燕谈录·文儒》

moral.zh: 常读好书、边读边想，知识会一点点拓宽我们的眼界。
moral.en: Good books widen our view when we read often and think about what we find.

idiomMeaning.zh: 打开书本阅读就会有收获；形容读书对人有益。
idiomMeaning.en: Opening a book brings benefit—reading can always offer something to learn.

visualAnchor: Early Northern Song palace library with tall dark-wood shelves, latticed windows, woven mats and warm daylight; Emperor Taizong is shown primarily as a devoted middle-aged reader with broad calm face, short moustache and beard, black scholar cap, deep-maroon plain robe, muted-gold sash and no ceremonial weapons; two scholar editors wear navy and moss robes; fixed large set of cream stitched volumes stored in pale-blue cloth cases, with only abstract ink marks and no legible characters; reading scenes are quiet, curious and collaborative

pages.zh: 宋太宗请学者编成一大套书，里面收集了许多知识。
pages.en: Emperor Taizong asked scholars to gather many kinds of knowledge into a great collection.
pages.prompt: wide establishing palace library, Taizong and two editors stand beside orderly shelves and the fixed pale-blue book cases

pages.zh: 书编好以后，他决定每天认真读三卷。
pages.en: When the collection was finished, he decided to read three volumes each day.
pages.prompt: Taizong selects exactly three cream stitched volumes from one pale-blue case at a low reading desk

pages.zh: 有时事情太多，他也会找安静时间把当天的书读完。
pages.en: Even on busy days, he found a quiet time to finish his reading.
pages.prompt: evening library scene, Taizong reads one open volume by a safe covered lamp after setting aside official work objects with no visible writing

pages.zh: 读到不懂的地方，他就停下来，请学者一起讨论。
pages.en: When a passage puzzled him, he paused and discussed it with the scholars.
pages.prompt: collaborative discussion around the low desk, Taizong asks a question while both editors compare two open books, no readable text

pages.zh: 书里有历史、山川、草木，也有前人的经验和办法。
pages.en: The books held history, landscapes, plants, and lessons from people of earlier times.
pages.prompt: imaginative but single continuous library scene, open volumes display text-free painted miniatures of mountains, crops and tools while readers observe

pages.zh: 每天多懂一点，他处理问题时也能看得更全面。
pages.en: Learning a little each day helped him see questions from more than one side.
pages.prompt: Taizong compares a small landscape model and a book illustration while scholars point out different details, thoughtful expressions

pages.zh: 他说：“只要打开好书认真读，开卷就会有益。”
pages.en: He said that opening a worthwhile book with care would always bring benefit.
pages.prompt: turning point, Taizong closes one finished volume with a satisfied thoughtful smile as morning light fills the library

pages.zh: 后来，他仍常常读书，也提醒大家边读边想、选择好书。
pages.en: He kept reading and encouraged others to choose good books and think as they read.
pages.prompt: hopeful library ending, Taizong and several young adult scholars read at separate desks in warm daylight, calm shared learning

title: 鹬蚌相争
subtitle: 河滩上的小争执

moral.zh: 只顾争斗会让双方都失去选择；及时停下、合作解决，才不会让别人得利。
moral.en: Endless struggle traps both sides; pausing to cooperate protects everyone's choices.

idiomMeaning.zh: 鹬和蚌互不相让，反被渔人一起捉住；比喻双方相争，让第三方得利。
idiomMeaning.en: A snipe and a clam fought until a fisher could take both—two rivals struggle while a third party gains.

visualAnchor: Ancient northern river shallows with pale sandbar, reeds, smooth stones and sparkling spring water; fixed child-friendly shorebird is a slim warm-brown snipe with cream chest, long dark beak, amber eyes and delicate gray legs; fixed freshwater clam has a rounded blue-gray shell with soft lavender inner edge and expressive eyes visible only when open; elderly fisher has kind weathered face, gray low bun, short beard, indigo robe, straw cape and an empty woven basket, with no hooks, blades or nets; all animal action is gentle and non-injurious

pages.zh: 春天的河滩上，一只河蚌张开贝壳，舒舒服服晒太阳。
pages.en: On a spring sandbar, a river clam opened its shell and basked in the sun.
pages.prompt: wide establishing river scene, the open blue-gray clam rests at the water's edge among reeds and smooth stones

pages.zh: 一只鹬鸟走来啄小虫，不小心把长嘴伸到了蚌边。
pages.en: A snipe searched for tiny insects and accidentally reached too close to the clam.
pages.prompt: the warm-brown snipe gently probes damp sand beside the open clam, accidental closeness, no injury

pages.zh: 河蚌吓了一跳，立刻合住壳，夹住了鹬鸟的嘴。
pages.en: Startled, the clam shut its shell and held the bird's beak fast.
pages.prompt: clam lightly holds only the tip of the snipe's beak, both surprised, clear child-safe spacing with no pain or damage

pages.zh: 鹬说蚌会晒干，蚌说鹬会挨饿，谁也不肯先放开。
pages.en: Each warned the other of trouble, yet neither was willing to let go first.
pages.prompt: snipe and clam exchange stubborn expressive looks on the sandbar, fixed positions, no speech bubbles

pages.zh: 一位渔人提着空篮走近，看见它们动也动不了。
pages.en: A fisher approached with an empty basket and saw that neither could move.
pages.prompt: elderly fisher notices the stuck pair from several steps away, empty woven basket visible, animals remain unharmed

pages.zh: 鹬和蚌这才发现，再争下去，双方都会失去自由。
pages.en: Only then did the two realize that continued struggle would cost both their freedom.
pages.prompt: close turning realization, bird and clam glance toward the approaching basket and then at each other, expressions soften

pages.zh: 河蚌松开贝壳，鹬也退后一步，它们终于停止相争。
pages.en: The clam opened, and the snipe stepped back. At last, they ended the struggle.
pages.prompt: clam safely releases the beak and snipe takes one respectful step back, fisher pauses and smiles gently

pages.zh: 渔人空篮离开，鹬和蚌记住：合作比僵持更有办法。
pages.en: The fisher left with an empty basket, while the pair remembered that cooperation beats a standoff.
pages.prompt: hopeful river ending, fisher walks away with empty basket as snipe and open clam share the sunny sandbar peacefully

title: 入木三分
subtitle: 写进木板的笔力

moral.zh: 深厚本领来自长期认真练习；观察得深入，表达也会更有力量。
moral.en: Deep skill grows from careful practice, and close understanding gives expression real strength.

idiomMeaning.zh: 墨迹深入木板三分；原来形容书法笔力强劲，后来也比喻见解或描写深刻。
idiomMeaning.en: Ink penetrating deep into wood—first praising powerful calligraphy, later describing insight or expression of great depth.

visualAnchor: Eastern Jin scholar's garden studio with bamboo, dark wooden veranda, low writing table and warm morning light; Wang Xizhi is an elegant slim 40-year-old man with long oval clean-shaven face, high scholar bun, flowing ivory robe, deep-teal sash and charcoal outer shawl; his young assistant wears a moss-green robe and beige sash; fixed rectangular pale-cypress signboard, dark-wood brush, black inkstone and clean water bowl; brush marks must remain abstract flowing black strokes with no legible Chinese characters

pages.zh: 东晋书法家王羲之从小爱写字，天天观察、天天练习。
pages.en: The calligrapher Wang Xizhi loved brushwork and practiced with careful observation every day.
pages.prompt: wide establishing garden studio, Wang Xizhi practices abstract brush strokes at the low table while assistant prepares paper

pages.zh: 他看鹅游水、看云舒展，把看到的力量记在心里。
pages.en: He watched geese glide and clouds unfold, remembering the movement he saw.
pages.prompt: Wang Xizhi observes two white geese gliding across a garden pond beneath long clouds, thoughtful pose

pages.zh: 写字时，他坐得稳、握笔松，落笔却沉着有力。
pages.en: At the desk, his posture was steady, his grip relaxed, and every stroke controlled.
pages.prompt: medium studio view, Wang Xizhi holds the fixed brush naturally and paints one bold abstract stroke, assistant watches

pages.zh: 一次，他在木板上写下几笔，墨色又匀又深。
pages.en: One day he brushed several balanced, powerful marks onto a wooden board.
pages.prompt: Wang Xizhi paints several abstract black flowing marks across the fixed pale-cypress signboard, no readable characters

pages.zh: 后来工匠刨去木板表面，发现里面还有清楚的墨痕。
pages.en: Later, a craftsperson planed the surface and found ink still visible beneath it.
pages.prompt: adult craftsperson safely shaves a thin curl from one edge of the board on a workbench while Wang and assistant stand back, dark ink visible within the wood grain

pages.zh: 墨迹竟深入木头，人们惊叹他的笔力入木三分。
pages.en: The ink had sunk deep into the wood, and everyone marveled at the strength of his brush.
pages.prompt: close storytelling view of the board's planed edge showing dark ink within pale wood, three adults react with quiet amazement

pages.zh: 王羲之说，好笔力不是一天练成，而是日积月累。
pages.en: Wang explained that such control came from practice gathered day after day.
pages.prompt: turning point, Wang Xizhi speaks modestly beside stacks of practice sheets with abstract marks, assistant listens

pages.zh: 他仍旧每天提笔，让每一笔都比昨天更准确、更有神。
pages.en: He kept practicing, making each new stroke more precise and alive than the last.
pages.prompt: hopeful sunset studio ending, Wang practices one fresh abstract stroke as geese rest by the pond outside

title: 凿壁偷光
subtitle: 墙缝里的一束光

moral.zh: 条件有限也能主动想办法，但使用别人的东西要先说明、守规则并注意安全。
moral.en: Resourcefulness matters, together with permission, fairness, and safety when we share what belongs to others.

idiomMeaning.zh: 匡衡在墙上凿孔借邻家的灯光读书；形容在困难条件下仍刻苦学习。
idiomMeaning.en: Kuang Heng opened a wall gap to borrow a neighbor's lamplight—a story of determined study despite hardship.

visualAnchor: Western Han rural village with two adjoining clay-brick homes, thatched roofs and simple wooden interiors; Kuang Heng is a diligent slim 13-year-old boy with round face, one small topknot, faded sky-blue short robe, brown sash, charcoal trousers and cloth shoes; kind neighbor is a sturdy 45-year-old man with short moustache, low bun, ochre robe and dark-teal sash; fixed stable covered oil lamp sits far from cloth and straw; fixed old wall has one small existing crack later widened and safely framed by an adult carpenter; books are honey-brown bamboo slips with abstract ink marks only

pages.zh: 汉代少年匡衡很爱读书，可家里晚上没有灯。
pages.en: Young Kuang Heng loved to read, but his family had no lamp at night.
pages.prompt: wide establishing adjoining homes at dusk, Kuang Heng holds a closed bamboo-slip book in his dim room while warm light glows next door

pages.zh: 白天干完活，他就趁天还亮，抓紧读几页竹简。
pages.en: After daytime chores, he used every remaining ray of daylight to study.
pages.prompt: Kuang Heng reads bamboo slips beside an open doorway in late-afternoon light, simple tidy home

pages.zh: 一天，他发现旧墙缝里透来邻居灯火的一线亮光。
pages.en: One evening, he noticed a thin beam from the neighbor's lamp shining through an old wall crack.
pages.prompt: dim room scene, one narrow warm beam passes through the fixed existing wall crack onto Kuang Heng's bamboo slips

pages.zh: 邻居知道后，请大人把墙缝安全地修成一个小光孔。
pages.en: When the neighbor heard, an adult safely framed the gap into a small light opening.
pages.prompt: kind neighbor and adult carpenter safely tidy the tiny opening with hand tools while Kuang Heng stands well back, covered lamp stable next door

pages.zh: 夜里，他坐在光孔旁安静读书，不碰灯，也不打扰邻居。
pages.en: At night, he read quietly by the shared light without touching the lamp or disturbing the home next door.
pages.prompt: Kuang Heng reads in his room beside the small framed light opening, warm beam on bamboo slips, lamp visible safely in neighboring room

pages.zh: 为了读更多书，他还帮藏书人做事，换来借书的机会。
pages.en: To reach more books, he worked for a book owner in exchange for time to read them.
pages.prompt: daytime courtyard library, Kuang Heng neatly stacks bamboo-slip bundles while an elderly book owner offers another volume

pages.zh: 人们用凿壁偷光，赞美他在困难中仍不放弃学习。
pages.en: People remembered the borrowed beam as a sign of learning that would not give up.
pages.prompt: turning point, Kuang Heng studies confidently by the small beam as several finished book bundles rest nearby

pages.zh: 那束小小的光，陪他把一个个不懂的问题慢慢照亮。
pages.en: That little beam helped him illuminate one question after another.
pages.prompt: hopeful dawn ending, sunrise joins the fading lamp beam as Kuang Heng closes a finished bamboo book with a grateful smile

title: 囊萤夜读
subtitle: 萤火虫的小灯笼

moral.zh: 珍惜条件、善用办法能帮助学习，也要爱护生命、保护眼睛并按时休息。
moral.en: Use what you have with care, while protecting living things, your eyes, and your need for rest.

idiomMeaning.zh: 车胤把萤火虫装在薄囊里借光读书；形容条件艰苦仍勤奋学习。
idiomMeaning.en: Che Yin read by fireflies gathered in a thin pouch—a symbol of diligent study in difficult conditions.

visualAnchor: Eastern Jin countryside home beside a summer meadow, with thatched roof, bamboo window, low desk and moonlit garden; Che Yin is a curious slim 12-year-old boy with oval face, one neat topknot, moss-green short robe, cream sash, brown trousers and cloth shoes; his mother is a gentle 38-year-old woman with low bun, muted-plum robe and beige apron; fixed loose translucent white silk pouch contains several glowing fireflies with fresh grass and wide breathable weave, never sealed or crowded; books are bamboo slips with no legible writing; fireflies are handled briefly and released before bedtime

pages.zh: 晋代少年车胤喜欢读书，可家里常常点不起灯。
pages.en: Che Yin loved books, but his family could not always afford a lamp.
pages.prompt: wide establishing summer home at twilight, Che Yin reads beside the last window light while mother tends the simple room

pages.zh: 夏夜里，他看见草丛中许多萤火虫一闪一闪。
pages.en: One summer night, he saw fireflies blinking across the meadow.
pages.prompt: Che Yin and mother watch many fireflies glow above grass and wildflowers under a bright moon

pages.zh: 他做了一个透气的薄纱囊，请几只萤火虫暂时住进去。
pages.en: He made a loose, airy silk pouch and let a few fireflies rest inside for a short while.
pages.prompt: mother helps Che Yin hold the fixed open-weave silk pouch near grass as a few fireflies enter gently, no grabbing

pages.zh: 点点微光聚在一起，像一盏柔和的小灯笼。
pages.en: Their tiny lights gathered into a soft little lantern.
pages.prompt: close warm scene, the breathable pouch glows softly beside fresh grass, fireflies spacious and unharmed

pages.zh: 车胤把书放近一些，只读一小会儿，让眼睛不太累。
pages.en: Che Yin brought the book closer and read only briefly so his eyes would not tire.
pages.prompt: Che Yin reads one bamboo-slip section at the low desk with glowing pouch nearby and moonlight through window, upright safe posture

pages.zh: 读完以后，他和母亲把萤火虫送回清凉的草地。
pages.en: When he finished, he and his mother returned every firefly to the cool meadow.
pages.prompt: Che Yin opens the pouch above the grass as all fireflies drift free, mother watches with a gentle smile

pages.zh: 囊萤夜读的故事，留下了珍惜条件、勤奋求知的精神。
pages.en: The firefly-light story became a symbol of making the most of every chance to learn.
pages.prompt: turning point, Che Yin rolls up the bamboo book and looks gratefully toward the free fireflies across the meadow

pages.zh: 夜深了，他按时休息，等明天再借太阳光继续读。
pages.en: When night grew late, he rested and waited for tomorrow's sunlight to read again.
pages.prompt: hopeful ending, Che Yin sleeps peacefully while closed bamboo books rest on the desk and fireflies glow outside the window

title: 三顾茅庐
subtitle: 第三次终于见面

moral.zh: 真诚邀请别人合作，需要尊重、耐心，也要认真听见对方的想法。
moral.en: Sincere collaboration begins with respect, patience, and real attention to another person's ideas.

idiomMeaning.zh: 刘备三次到茅庐拜访诸葛亮；比喻诚心诚意地一再邀请贤能的人。
idiomMeaning.en: Liu Bei visited Zhuge Liang's cottage three times—repeatedly and sincerely seeking a capable person's help.

visualAnchor: Late Eastern Han Longzhong countryside with terraced fields, bamboo, pine trees and one fixed neat thatched cottage behind a low woven fence; Liu Bei is a calm 38-year-old man with long oval face, short moustache and beard, high bun, deep-teal traveling robe, cream scarf and brown cloak; Guan Yu is tall with long neat dark beard, deep-rust robe and dark-green cloak; Zhang Fei is sturdy with round face, short beard, ochre robe and charcoal cloak; Zhuge Liang is a slim 27-year-old scholar with clean-shaven oval face, high scholar bun, ivory robe, muted-blue sash, gray outer shawl and fixed white feather fan; no armor or weapons

pages.zh: 刘备听说诸葛亮很有智慧，想请他一起做重要的事。
pages.en: Liu Bei heard of Zhuge Liang's wisdom and hoped to invite him to work together.
pages.prompt: wide establishing Longzhong landscape, Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei walk toward the fixed thatched cottage across terraced fields

pages.zh: 第一次来到茅庐，诸葛亮正好外出，他们只好回去。
pages.en: On the first visit, Zhuge Liang was away, so the travelers returned home.
pages.prompt: three visitors wait politely outside the closed cottage gate while a young household helper explains that Zhuge Liang is away

pages.zh: 第二次冒着冬雪来访，还是没能见到他。
pages.en: They came again through light winter snow, but still did not find him home.
pages.prompt: same three visitors beneath warm cloaks at the cottage gate in gentle snow, safe path and patient expressions

pages.zh: 张飞有些着急，刘备却说：“真心邀请，就要有耐心。”
pages.en: Zhang Fei grew impatient, but Liu Bei reminded him that sincerity requires patience.
pages.prompt: on the return path, Zhang Fei gestures with mild frustration while Liu Bei answers calmly and Guan Yu listens

pages.zh: 春天，他们第三次来到茅庐，诸葛亮正在屋里午睡。
pages.en: In spring they visited a third time and found Zhuge Liang resting inside.
pages.prompt: spring cottage courtyard, three visitors arrive as helper quietly indicates the sleeping scholar inside behind a screen

pages.zh: 刘备安静等在门外，直到诸葛亮醒来开门相迎。
pages.en: Liu Bei waited quietly until Zhuge Liang awoke and welcomed them in.
pages.prompt: Liu Bei waits beneath the eaves while companions stand farther back; Zhuge Liang opens the cottage door warmly with feather fan

pages.zh: 两人认真交谈，诸葛亮被这份诚意打动，愿意相助。
pages.en: They spoke at length, and Zhuge Liang accepted the sincere invitation to help.
pages.prompt: turning point inside cottage, Liu Bei and Zhuge Liang discuss a text-free cloth map at low table while companions listen respectfully

pages.zh: 三顾茅庐让大家记住：尊重和耐心，能请来真心的合作。
pages.en: The three visits showed how respect and patience can begin a wholehearted partnership.
pages.prompt: hopeful cottage farewell, four men step together onto the spring path as equal collaborators, bamboo and fields glowing

title: 精卫填海
subtitle: 衔着石子的勇敢小鸟

moral.zh: 面对巨大的困难，坚持能积累勇气；也要找到安全、合适并能真正推进的办法。
moral.en: Persistence builds courage before a great challenge, especially when joined with safe and useful steps.

idiomMeaning.zh: 精卫鸟不停衔来木石，想把大海填平；比喻意志坚定、不畏艰难。
idiomMeaning.en: The bird Jingwei carried twigs and stones to fill the sea—a symbol of steadfast will before immense difficulty.

visualAnchor: Mythic ancient eastern coast with dark-blue sea, pale cliffs, red sunrise and forested Fajiu Mountain; Nüwa is a brave 10-year-old girl with round face, two small side buns tied with coral ribbons, coral-red cross-collar dress, cream sash and dark cloth shoes; her fixed tiny wooden boat has curved ends and no sail; Jingwei is a small child-friendly dark-blue bird with patterned black-and-white head, white beak, red feet, warm amber eyes and rounded wings; transformation is symbolic and luminous, never showing drowning, injury or fear; fixed smooth gray pebbles and short dry twigs

pages.zh: 传说炎帝的小女儿女娃，最喜欢到东海边看日出。
pages.en: Legend says Nüwa, the youngest daughter of the Flame Emperor, loved watching sunrise by the Eastern Sea.
pages.prompt: wide establishing sunrise coast, Nüwa stands safely on pale cliff path beside the fixed tiny wooden boat pulled onto shore

pages.zh: 一天海风忽然变大，小船在远处的浪花间摇晃起来。
pages.en: One day the wind rose suddenly, and her little boat rocked among distant waves.
pages.prompt: distant wide sea scene, tiny boat rides broad but non-scary waves while Nüwa holds the sides steadily, coast still visible

pages.zh: 古老的故事说，风浪过后，女娃化成了一只精卫鸟。
pages.en: The old tale says that after the storm, Nüwa became a bird called Jingwei.
pages.prompt: symbolic luminous transformation above now-calm water, coral-colored glow becomes the fixed small Jingwei bird, empty boat floating safely nearby, no distress

pages.zh: 精卫望着大海，决定从山上衔来树枝和小石子。
pages.en: Looking across the sea, Jingwei decided to carry twigs and pebbles from the mountain.
pages.prompt: Jingwei perches on Fajiu Mountain beside fixed pebbles and twigs, gazing toward the vast sea with determined gentle eyes

pages.zh: 它一次衔一颗石子，飞过山谷，再轻轻放进海里。
pages.en: One pebble at a time, she flew across the valley and dropped it gently into the sea.
pages.prompt: Jingwei flies safely above the coast carrying exactly one small gray pebble in white beak, wide scale shows mountain and sea

pages.zh: 大海那么辽阔，小鸟却天天来，从来不说放弃。
pages.en: The sea was vast, but the little bird returned day after day without giving up.
pages.prompt: single continuous dawn scene, Jingwei places one twig beside a small tidy line of pebbles at the shoreline, subtle repeated flight tracks without montage

pages.zh: 人们用精卫填海，赞美面对困难仍坚定前行的勇气。
pages.en: People remembered Jingwei's work as courage that keeps moving before a great challenge.
pages.prompt: turning point, Jingwei rests on a driftwood branch above the pebble-lined shore, sunrise behind and expression quietly resolute

pages.zh: 每一次小小行动，都让它更勇敢，也让后来的人记住坚持。
pages.en: Every small action strengthened her courage and left later generations a lesson in persistence.
pages.prompt: hopeful final sunrise, Jingwei flies along the glowing coast with one small twig, a few other birds accompany at a respectful distance, vast sea peaceful
